title: NAND requires two queries on the all-negative input
statement: Let $T$ be a finite decision tree on two coordinates whose input values and output labels are signs in $\{-1,1\}$. Suppose that on every input it outputs $1$ exactly when both coordinates equal $-1$, and outputs $-1$ otherwise. On the input with both coordinates equal to $-1$, the tree makes exactly two queries.
hypotheses_covered: A finite decision tree on two coordinates
The tree computes the function equal to $1$ when both coordinates are $-1$ and $-1$ otherwise
The input with both coordinates equal to $-1$
